ac_results.reason: Immutable baseline with hash/version/pricingVersion/items/amendedFrom, explicit amendBaseline increments version; projection = confirmed+pending_upper+remaining+repair with reserved displayed separately not double-counted; pending=null => unbounded requires reconcile.

Strict >10% (forecast*10 > baseline*11): +9% no alert, exactly +10% no alert, +10.01% alert; cumulative rises vs original baseline; zero baseline any positive requires approval; stale/unknown/unbounded => stale_or_unbounded with refresh required; hard cap blocks even below +10%; FX via minor units.

Notifications dedup by scopeId:baselineId:v{version}:outcome, version bump resets dedup, requiresApproval separate from notification; ack returns ack key but does not imply approval (approval is new amended baseline); final report contains original/latest approved/actual/all attempts.

risks: Prototype thresholds use in-memory CostBaseline, not yet Postgres price version/checked_at/validity expiry
Hard cap enforcement is evaluation-time decision, not yet wired to BudgetLedger reserve deny
Dedup is in-memory Set, needs persisted notification state in production
